What Is IPTV?

IPTV stands for Internet Protocol Television. Instead of receiving television through traditional cable or satellite delivery, IPTV uses an internet connection to deliver live channels and, depending on the service, on-demand content.

IPTV technology itself is not automatically illegal. The important question is whether the provider has permission to distribute the content it offers.
For viewers in the USA, choosing a legitimate service with properly licensed programming is the safest approach.

How to Choose the Best IPTV Reddit Recommendations

Reddit can be useful when researching IPTV because you can find real users discussing their experiences. However, you shouldn't assume that the most frequently recommended service is automatically the best

Before subscribing, consider these factors:
Reliability
A large channel list doesn't matter much if streams constantly freeze. Look for consistent feedback about playback stability, especially during popular live sporting events.
Device Compatibility

Check whether the provider's recommended application works with your Samsung, LG, Android TV, Google TV, or other device.


Picture Quality

Look for realistic HD or 4K support rather than choosing a service simply because it advertises an enormous number of channels.

EPG Support

An Electronic Program Guide makes live television easier to navigate by showing current and upcoming programs.

Customer Support

Good support can save a lot of frustration when you experience login, playlist, or playback problems.

The basic setup is usually simple:
Connect your Smart TV to the internet.
Find an IPTV application supported by your provider.Install the application from your TV's official app store when available.
Open the application.Enter the login, activation code, or playlist information supplied by your provider.

The exact process depends on your television's operating system.

How to Set Up IPTV on Samsung TV

On compatible Samsung Smart TVs, press Home, open Apps, and search for the IPTV application supported by your service.

Select the application and choose Install. After installation, open it and enter your provider's account or activation details.

Samsung notes that app availability can vary depending on the TV model, software version, and region.
If you cannot find a particular IPTV application, it doesn't necessarily mean something is wrong with your television. The application may simply not be supported on your model or in your region.

How to Set Up IPTV on LG TV

LG Smart TVs use webOS and provide applications through their app ecosystem.
Press Home, open Apps, search for the compatible IPTV application, and select Install. Once installed, open the app and enter the information provided by your IPTV service.

Like Samsung, LG application availability can vary by country, model, and region.

Why Is My IPTV Buffering?

Buffering isn't always caused by slow internet.

Try these basic fixes:
  • Restart the IPTV application.
  • Restart your Smart TV.
  • Reboot your router.
  • Test another channel.
  • Move from Wi-Fi to Ethernet if possible.
Check whether buffering happens only during busy periods.

If other streaming services work perfectly while one IPTV stream repeatedly fails, the problem may be related to that particular stream or provider rather than your internet connection.

  • Pricing and terms
  • Customer support
  • Cancellation policy

Avoid services that make unrealistic promises or require you to install suspicious software from unknown sources.

FAQ

What is the best IPTV according to Reddit?

There isn't one universally agreed best IPTV service on Reddit. Recommendations vary based on location, device, channels, sports requirements, and individual experiences.

Can I install IPTV directly on a Smart TV?

Yes, if a compatible application is available for your TV's operating system. Otherwise, you may need a supported external streaming device.

Do I need a Fire TV Stick for IPTV?

Not necessarily. A Smart TV can run IPTV directly when the required application is supported.
Why does IPTV buffer with fast internet?

Possible causes include Wi-Fi interference, network congestion, latency, packet loss, application problems, or issues with the stream itself.

Is IPTV legal in the USA?

IPTV technology is a legitimate way to deliver television over the internet. However, providers need appropriate rights to distribute the content they offer. Choose services that properly license their programming.

Final Thoughts

Searching for the best IPTV Reddit recommendations can give you useful starting points, but don't choose a service based on channel count or a single Reddit comment.

title: Running, Walking, and Exploring: Midlife Miles
author: Sandi Lake, Running and Walking Coach
description:
I'm Sandi Lake and I've been running for 50 years, which is a bit ironic since I was the least athletic girl in my PE class. I stuggled with hand-eye coordination and had to be placed (not picked) on a team in PE just so the numbers worked. That's who I was.
Fast forward: I've completed 16 full marathons, 100+ half marathons and more shorter distances than I can cound -- including 7 World Major Marathons (New York, Chicago, Boston, Berlin, London, Tokyo and Sydney). My second Boston Marathon and each of the international marathos happeded after I turned 60. I'm still running, still race directing for non-profit organizations that need someone who understand what it takes to get people to the starting line and cheer them on at the finish line. 
Do you find yourself asking:
-Is it too late or am I to old to start running or walking?
-How do I get started and stay motivated when everything hurts a little more than it used to?
-What does it actually look like to keep moving - physically and in life - through the midlife chapter?
This podcast is for you if:
-You're navigating midlife and want to start or keep moving.
-You want real talk instead of empty motivation.
-You want to be at the starting line instead of on the sidelines
-You want proof that adventure, momentum, and reinvention are very possible - no matter where you are starting from!
Midlife Miles is built around three things I believe are deeply connected:
1. Movement & Training:
   Practical topics - running, walking, and exploring incluidng how to actually get going and keep going. 
2. Life in Motion: 
    The mindset, resilience and reinvention that comes with our stage of life. 
3. Adventure & Travel: 
    Moving forward should sometimes mean a passport stamp, not just a training log. 
    Running, walking, & exploring through midlife in whatever form that means for you.

title: Change Your Life with Dr Amen Kaur: Build Self Love, Self Worth, Self Confidence and the Courage to Achieve Your Goals
author: Dr. Amen Kaur
description:
You have something of immense value to give. Something happened, and now you feel unsure of yourself.  You doubt yourself and your self confidence has gone.
Maybe it was redundancy, or a divorce, or a new manager who chipped away at your value until you stopped trusting yourself. Maybe you were quietly managed out. Maybe nothing dramatic happened at all and you have just been asking, is this it? Either way you want more, you cannot go back to what it was, and you cannot make yourself move forward the way you used to.
That is not a strategy problem.
Most advice gives you one half of the answer. One half is all structure, the plans and the tactics, with no inner foundation to hold it up, so what is really driving you is fear and proving yourself. The other half is all inner work, sitting with your feelings and never taking an action. Both leave you feeling stuck, lost, overwhelmed and burned out.
This show is about doing both, in the right order. Self love first, because when you do not have it you stop believing you are worth what you want. Then self worth, so you can trust what you know. Then self value, so you can express it and actually experience it. Then the systems and structures that make it compound. Build your value on the inside. Achieve your goals on the outside.
I'm Dr. Amen Kaur. I have spent over twenty years helping people achieve their goals, including as a partner in an FTSE 250 business. I am a researcher at heart, so I look for the root cause rather than treating the symptom. What I bring you here is research, science and spirituality, because the convergence of all three brings us to a core truth.
Each week we look at answering the questions you are actually asking. How do I start my life over? What do I actually want? How do I find my purpose after losing my job? How do I deal with a career change when I have no idea what I want next? How do I recover after a breakup or a divorce? How do I start a business when I don't know what I want and my confidence has gone? Is it too late to start over? Should I start a business, or go back to a job after self-employment? Is a career coach worth it?
And underneath those, the questions that decide the answer. Why do I keep self sabotaging. Why do I procrastinate. Why do I people please and over give and prove my worth. Why does my confidence go when someone devalues me. Why do I keep attracting toxic relationships and toxic bosses. Why do I feel undervalued when I know I'm good at what I do. How do I stop feeling anxious about a decision I already know I want to make.
We work through self love, self worth and self value, and the practical, tactical things they let you do. Getting the promotion. Building the business. Finding career clarity when you are feeling stuck mid career. Setting boundaries without guilt. Regulating your nervous system so you can think straight. Building the systems and structures that compound, at work and in a business, so the results keep coming without you burning yourself out to get them.
You cannot be told your value. You have to experience it.
If you are feeling lost, feeling stuck, or wondering what to do next, start with any episode and see what lands.

title: The Defining Move | Leadership and CEO Evolution for Scaling Businesses
author: Richard Medcalf | CEO Strategic Leadership & CEO Transformation Expert
description:
As a founder or CEO scaling your business, what do you do when the next big leap isn't happening fast enough?
Most CEOs respond by making time for strategy, improving strategic execution, hiring stronger leaders, or working even harder.
Eventually you hit a business plateau, because the real constraint isn't strategy or systems. It’s Leadership Leverage – your ability to make bolder decisions, break the CEO bottleneck, build executive team ownership, and create a scaling culture.
And leverage grows when a CEO makes a defining move – an irreversible decision that changes who they must become to lead the next version of the business.
That's what this show explores.
The Defining Move is a podcast about CEO leadership for scaling businesses, and the CEO transformation that drives the next level of growth.
Unlike other CEO leadership shows, we don’t discuss past successes. We watch what happens when elite leaders face high-stakes challenges.
In every episode, Richard Medcalf hands one of the world's most accomplished leaders a fictional defining move, already made, that changes the trajectory of their business.
You’ll learn from how they think and how they lead when the stakes rise. And you’ll discover the hidden sources of leadership leverage that take them to their next level, and will take you to yours.
Richard Medcalf, founder of Xquadrant, CEO coach, and author of Making TIME For Strategy and The 10X Reckoning, has advised founders and CEOs of scaling businesses for over 20 years – from disruptive scale-ups to billion-dollar corporations – on CEO leadership, CEO transformation, and executive team development.
The show helps founders and CEOs strengthen their CEO leadership, accelerate CEO evolution, and build businesses that can scale without becoming dependent on the founder.
Episodes explore founder & CEO leadership, CEO transformation, CEO accountability, executive team ownership, vision execution, strategic execution, strategic leadership, strategic decision making, leadership leverage, founder bottlenecks, CEO bottlenecks, scaling culture, CEO evolution, business plateaus, and the defining decisions behind extraordinary companies.
You'll also discover Richard's practical frameworks for CEO transformation: Leadership Leverage, Leadership Constraints, The Defining Move, The 10X Reckoning, and other ideas that help founders and CEOs evolve to lead organisations that scale faster than their own personal capacity.
Questions we explore include:
How do you break the founder/CEO bottleneck?  
What creates leadership leverage?  
How do you build executive team ownership and accountability?  
Why do leadership teams struggle with strategic execution?  
How do you create a scaling culture?  
How do you build an accountability culture?  
How do you scale without becoming the centre of every important decision?  
What separates CEOs who hit a business plateau from CEOs who create extraordinary businesses?  
What does CEO evolution entail?  
When is it time to make a defining move?  
How does CEO transformation drive business growth?
If you're building a scaling business and believe your next breakthrough depends on your own CEO evolution, not simply better strategic decision making, you'll feel at home here.
Popular Episode Topics Include: CEO Leadership, CEO Transformation, CEO Accountability, Executive Team Ownership, Founder Bottleneck, CEO Operating System, Vision Execution, Vision Execution Gap, Strategic Leadership, Strategic Decision Making, Scaling Culture, Accountability Culture, Leadership Leverage, Organisational Leverage, Business Plateau, Scaling a Business Without Burnout, and CEO Evolution.
Previously published as The Impact Multiplier CEO, this podcast continues to explore CEO leadership for scaling businesses through a new format centred on defining decisions and CEO transformation.

Through deep research, rare stories, and exclusive interviews with key figures involved in the album’s creation, including Young Guru, Bink and Just Blaze, the podcast goes behind the music to uncover the people, places, ideas and pivotal moments that shaped one of the most influential albums in Rap history.



Originally produced and released by Breaking Atoms in 2021 to celebrate the 20th anniversary of The Blueprint, this acclaimed podcast returns for the album’s 25th anniversary with newly remastered audio. From the soul samples and stripped-back production to Jay-Z’s defining performances and the intense circumstances surrounding its release, hear the story of how The Blueprint came together - and why its influence can still be felt a quarter of a century later.

title: The Big Picture on China
author: Mark Llewellyn & Andy Byrne
description:
An hour from Beijing is a mysterious province of 75 million people that the outside world has never heard of.


Episode one of The Big Picture goes into Hebei, where every city builds something the world buys, and meets the canny Aussie who got there 26 years early and made a fortune on nothing but a handshake.


Don't Break the China!


For five years, The Big Picture has covered Australia-China business from the places everyone knows: Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hong Kong. This year we went somewhere else. An hour from Beijing lies a province of 75 million people the outside world has never heard of. It's shaped like a doughnut, and the hole in the middle is Beijing. For centuries the capital took the glory while Hebei did the work.


Now Hebei is opening up, and we got the first invitation. There's no guidebook, so we made one.


Every city here has a speciality, and every speciality is world-scale: enough handbags a year to circle the equator eight times; more steel than America and Australia combined, now going green; a new city run by AI and Shakespeare-quoting robots.


But the real story is people, and the long game. We meet entrepreneurs like Bob, who arrived in 1999 with one friend and no Mandarin, and made a fortune. The question isn't can you do business in Hebei. It's why aren't you there already?

title: Growing Plants Growing People
author: Kristian Hickson-Booth and Daniel Locklair
description:
What if some of the principles that help gardens flourish could also help us understand how people grow?


Welcome to Growing Plants, Growing People™ — the podcast where we discover that the principles which help gardens flourish are often the very same principles that help people grow.

Hosted by Kristian Hickson-Booth and Daniel Locklair, we bring together very different backgrounds and experiences with a shared professional foundation in Self-Talk and Life Coaching — and a fascination with one of the most extraordinary gardens of all: the human mind.


Together, we explore Self-Talk, programming, beliefs, habits, neuroplasticity, personal growth and the often unseen influences that shape the way we think, feel, act and ultimately the results we create in our lives.


This isn't simply about positive thinking. It's about understanding what's happening beneath the surface — where our programming comes from, how our brains learn and change, why lasting change can sometimes be difficult, and what we can do differently once we begin to understand the processes involved.


Through conversation, personal stories, practical ideas and lessons drawn from both personal development and the garden, our aim is to help you understand yourself a little better, question some of the things you've come to believe, and recognise that change is possible.


Because whether we're growing plants or growing people, what happens beneath the surface matters.

And remember: the most important conversation you'll ever have is the one you have with yourself. Make it count.

If you could easily and freely help your brothers and sisters in Christ, would you do so?

Today, social media gives us an extraordinary opportunity to do exactly that. A share, comment, recommendation, or conversation can help biblical truth travel farther, encourage fellow believers, and even help place Bibles into the hands of those who are persecuted for their faith in Jesus.

What could happen if Christians intentionally used their God-given influence—whether large or small—to help provide Bibles for the persecuted church?

Even one simple share could help put God’s Word into the hands of our persecuted brothers and sisters.

Learn more and join the experiment: 

www.TheChristianExperiment.com

In Christ Alone,

Mr. Jan Blonk

THE C-DIMENSIONGenre: Science Fiction • Mystery • Adventure • Creatures
Format: Serialized podcastSeries DescriptionWhat if there was another dimension hiding right next to ours—one humans were never supposed to enter?When 13-year-old Alex Carter discovers a strange glowing device buried beneath an abandoned science facility, he accidentally activates it and opens a portal to a completely unknown universe: the C-Dimension.The C-Dimension is nothing like Earth. Its skies change color, islands float above enormous oceans, forests move when nobody is watching, and thousands of strange creatures live across different regions.Some creatures are friendly.Some are intelligent.And some have been waiting for humans to arrive.But Alex soon discovers something much bigger than himself is happening.A powerful technology company called ProXo has discovered the C-Dimension too. ProXo doesn't want to explore it—they want to control it.Their plan is to build portals, capture the creatures, take the dimension's resources, and eventually bring the entire C-Dimension under ProXo's control.Alex becomes trapped on the other side of the portal and finds himself caught between two forces: the mysterious creatures of the C-Dimension and the growing army of ProXo explorers.To get home, Alex must travel through the unknown regions of the dimension, uncover the secrets of the creatures, and discover why the C-Dimension may have been hiding from Earth for thousands of years.But there's one terrifying question:Why did the C-Dimension let Alex in?And what happens if it decides to let everyone else in too?The C-DimensionThe dimension contains mysterious environments unlike anything on Earth:🌌 The Skylands — Floating islands surrounded by purple clouds.🌊 The Mirror Ocean — An ocean that reflects places that don't exist.🏜️ The Shifting Desert — A desert where the landscape changes every night.⚡ The Storm Zone — A region permanently surrounded by enormous electrical storms.🏙️ The Forgotten City — An abandoned city built by an unknown civilization.CreaturesThe C-Dimension is filled with completely new lifeforms.Glowbacks — Small, friendly creatures that glow when danger is nearby.Razorwings — Fast flying creatures that travel in huge groups.Mimics — Creatures that can temporarily copy the appearance of other animals.Titanbeasts — Enormous creatures that can move entire pieces of the landscape.Void Crawlers — Mysterious creatures that appear near dimensional portals.The Cores — Ancient intelligent beings who may know the true origin of the C-Dimension.ProXoProXo claims it wants to "protect humanity through exploration."But behind the company's public image is a secret project called PROJECT CROWN.Its goal:Control the C-Dimension.ProXo builds machines capable of opening temporary portals, tracking creatures, and extracting energy from the dimension.But the more ProXo interferes with the C-Dimension, the stranger things become.Something beneath the dimension is waking up.And even ProXo doesn't know what it is.Season 1Episode 1 — The DoorAlex discovers the portal and enters the C-Dimension.Episode 2 — Something in the ForestAlex encounters his first creature—and realizes the creatures aren't all dangerous.Episode 3 — ProXoAlex discovers that ProXo has followed him through the portal.Episode 4 — The SkylandsAlex travels across floating islands while trying to avoid ProXo drones.Episode 5 — The Mirror OceanAlex discovers that the ocean can show visions of other dimensions.Episode 6 — Project CrownAlex learns what ProXo really wants.Episode 7 — The Forgotten CityAlex discovers evidence that someone from Earth may have visited the C-Dimension long ago.Episode 8 — The CoreAlex meets one of the mysterious Cores.Episode 9 — The CollapseProXo activates its largest portal yet—and something goes terribly wrong.Episode 10 — The Other SideAlex finally learns why the C-Dimension chose him.The season ends with Alex staring at a second portal.Except this portal isn't connected to Earth.It's connected to somewhere else.Season 2 Listen to Season 1 and continue to the next.

description:
Goddess Beauty Mysteries: Henna & Ancestral Wisdom Traditions is a podcast devoted to re-membering ancestral wisdom into the present for a more culturally and ecologically sustainable, beauty-filled future.
Hosted by Christine Shahin, author of Natural Hair Coloring and a longtime advocate for chemical-free beauty, this show explores the intersection of natural beauty, herbal hair coloring, traditional adornment, ecological awareness, and ancestral practices that still have a meaningful place in modern life.
If you are chemically sensitive, concerned about the ingredients in conventional beauty products, transitioning toward a more plant-based lifestyle, or simply looking for a deeper relationship with the products and rituals you use every day, this podcast is designed to be a trusted resource.
Christine draws from decades of experience as a folk herbalist, cosmetologist, natural salon and spa owner, educator, eco-activist, and henna practitioner. Through conversations, teachings, and stories, she shares practical ways to work with henna and other pure herbal pigments while exploring the broader cultural, environmental, and personal significance of these traditions.
Goddess Beauty Mysteries is about more than changing the way we color our hair or care for our bodies. It is an invitation to reconnect with plants, question extractive beauty practices, preserve traditional knowledge, and rediscover beauty as something rooted in relationship, sovereignty, and sustainability.
For the curious, the chemically sensitive, the plant-based, the beauty professional, and anyone seeking a more conscious approach to beauty, Christine invites you into a world where ancient wisdom and modern life can meet.

title: The Domain Names Podcast: Domain Investing, Buying and Selling Domains, Valuations, Auctions, Branding, SEO, and the Domain Name Industry
author: Podily & Josh Linsk
description:
The Domain Names Podcast, hosted by Josh Linsk, explores domain investing, buying and selling domain names, valuations, auctions, branding, SEO, aftermarket sales, registrars, marketplaces, and the business of digital real estate. Each episode examines how valuable domain names are discovered, priced, acquired, developed, negotiated, and sold, along with the strategies investors, entrepreneurs, startups, and established companies use to build stronger online brands.

The podcast covers premium domains, expired domains, one-word domains, short domains, .com investing, new domain extensions, country-code domains, brandable names, keyword domains, domain parking, leasing, financing, portfolio management, outbound sales, brokerage, escrow, transfers, renewals, and acquisition strategy. Episodes also explore major domain marketplaces and auction platforms, historical domain sales, valuation methods, comparable sales, search demand, backlinks, traffic, trademarks, naming trends, and the factors that can make one domain worth significantly more than another.

Hosted by Josh Linsk, The Domain Names Podcast looks closely at the companies, investors, brokers, registries, registrars, entrepreneurs, and technologies that have shaped the domain name industry. Topics include GoDaddy, Namecheap, Sedo, Afternic, Escrow.com, Atom, domain auctions, ICANN, DNS infrastructure, WHOIS, aftermarket platforms, portfolio acquisitions, corporate domain strategy, startup naming, rebranding, and the relationship between memorable domain names and business credibility.

Episodes also examine the history and evolution of the domain industry, from the earliest internet registrations and the rise of .com through the domain speculation boom, major multimillion-dollar sales, consolidation among registrars and marketplaces, alternative extensions, Web3 naming experiments, artificial intelligence, and changing approaches to online branding. The show explores both legendary domain transactions and the everyday economics of building and managing a profitable domain portfolio.

Whether you are a domain investor, entrepreneur, startup founder, marketer, SEO professional, brand strategist, broker, collector, or simply fascinated by the economics of internet addresses, The Domain Names Podcast with Josh Linsk provides an in-depth look at domain names as assets, brands, investments, and essential pieces of internet infrastructure.

title: Wellness While Walking
author: Carolyn Cohen
description:
Welcome! Each episode of Wellness While Walking addresses the real health concerns you're facing: 
•	metabolism shifts and blood sugar spikes/weight gain
•	establishing sustainable habits despite crazy-busy schedules
•	adapting movement regimens (featuring walking!*) to work for you… in a fun way!
•	implementing doable nutrition approaches that work with your midlife body and life
Hi, I'm Carolyn, a Certified Functional Medicine Health Coach of almost 20 years. 
I was a health-rejectionist! I didn't think it mattered what our lifestyles were like – I even doubled down on this approach, working in the ultra-processed foods industry for a decade (and gained a lot of weight and was fatigued all the time, but I didn't connect the dots!) But then I got very sick. And my young children did, too. I started to open up to the idea that what we ate, how (if!) we moved, how we slept and more – how it did matter! I "walked back" my chronic disease diagnoses and my kids healed. 
After over a decade of health coaching people in their midlife years, I also noticed another trend – that of extremes! Folks rejected things like walking and eating largely whole foods for their more intense counterparts, like running and "eating clean." I knew that I needed to fight this, because there are lots of health-conferring points in between on the spectrum, and I'm all about capitalizing on the low hanging fruit by taking small steps that we'll actually do and enjoy! 
I do think we need to fight societal norms that leave us unhealthy – we call that "walking against traffic" – but this can be a moderate, doable, fun and effective path! Getting this word out to the wider audience beyond my clientele led me to introduce the Wellness While Walking Podcast in January of 2020, and we've been going strong since!
I hope you'll join me, Health Coach Carolyn, for Wellness While Walking—your 30-minute movement companion that delivers research-backed strategies for weight management, metabolic health, healing chronic conditions and extending your healthspan in a motivating, compassionate format!
Whether you're seeking accountability for consistent action, clarity on conflicting health advice, or gentle guidance for aging vibrantly, Wellness While Walking meets you where you are with understanding and actionable solutions.
By the end of each episode, you'll feel physically energized, mentally renewed, and equipped with clear next steps—having moved, learned, laughed, and found the motivation to take the next meaningful step on your health journey! (*Did I mention that we play a beep halfway through so you know when to turn around if you're walking while listening?!)
Today is a terrific day to start so press "Follow" and then "Play," and let's do this, together!

title: Perspectives: A Canadian Journal of Political Economy and Social Democracy
author: Broadbent Institute
description:
The Perspectives Journal Podcast complements the journal and opinions content of Perspectives: A Canadian Journal of Political Economy and Social Democracy, to bring out left-wing ideas and strategy in a new and ever-evolving format. The podcast features interviews with policy experts, to dig deeper into the progressive angles of the issues affecting working-class, ordinary Canadians.

Hosted by editor-in-chief, Clement Nocos, the Perspectives Journal Podcast aims to bring forward timely analysis on issues from the multiple crises of the economy, cost-of-living and the environment, to the labour movement, as well as the state of Canadian democracy. The wide reaching breadth of this show aims to help inform policymakers and the public about approaches to today’s pressing problems that are rooted in Ed Broadbent’s Principles for Canadian Social Democracy.

Perspectives Journal also produces and features shows hosted by the Broadbent Institute’s friends and affiliates, providing a progressive platform for limited and irregular conversations that are still necessary to enliven Canada’s political discourse. The Perspectives Journal Podcast is a proud members of the Harbinger Media Network, Canada’s progressive podcast community.

---


Activists Make History

Activists Make History with Peggy Nash is a new podcast series from Perspectives Journal that finds the political underdogs and asks how they got started, against the odds, to fight for progressive change. Policymakers, activists and experts from underrepresented communities and backgrounds, that are typically pushed to the margins of Canadian political life, are front and centre in conversation with Peggy Nash, who has been a union activist, a feminist advocate, and a Member of Parliament in Canada’s House of Commons for nearly a decade.


---


Social Democrats of the North


In Social Democrats of the North: Canadian Visions for Justice & Equality from Confederation to the Quiet Revolution, Dave McGrane, Professor of Political Science at St. Thomas More College at the University of Saskatchewan, explores the life, times, and ideas of Canada’s most influential social democrats. From Confederation at 1867, to the Quiet Revolution of the 1960s, discover the people who shaped social democracy in Canada, the movements that fought for the working-class, and the legacies they’ve left for the wellbeing of all Canadians. There are lessons for activists, and forgotten struggles that apply to today’s wins. After all, the best teacher for a better world tomorrow, is the past.


---


Class & Climate


Class & Climate: Perspectives on a Green Economy is a new podcast series from Perspectives Journal and the Green Economy Network that explores how climate action can create good jobs, make life more affordable, and debunk the myth that workers and the environment are at odds. The Broadbent Institute is a member of the Green Economy Network. GEN brings together labour, environmental, faith, and social justice organizations. title: The Vardø Witch Trials
author: Lisa Williams
description:
Everyone knows Salem. Almost nobody knows Vardø.

At the very edge of Europe, above the Arctic Circle, there was a place people believed stood on the boundary between this world… and something else. A place where the Devil could enter the world.

In February 1692, the same month the Salem accusations began, the last victim of the Vardø witch trials was being brought to court. Salem was over in little more than a year. This had already been going on for 70 years.

91 people died, most of them women, in Norway's deadliest witch hunt.

It began in 1619, when a Scottish sea captain arrived in this isolated community, a coast full of widows. Then a terrifying belief took hold, that witches were living among them.

The mystery of their confessions has never been solved.

So, for the first time in a podcast series, I'm investigating this untold story.

Join me as I travel to the remotest parts of Norway, to the places where the women lived, were imprisoned and put to death. And I've been given rare access to the 17th century witch trial court books, with one of the few people alive who can still read them.

Whose words were really in those confessions?

And why did they kill so many women?

A historical true-crime investigation from Lisa Williams.

description:
Before Egypt by Robert Bloch is a fast-moving science-fiction adventure that blends ancient mystery, interplanetary travel, danger, and speculation about the origins of civilization.
The story follows Mike Mallison, a capable big-game guide who accepts one of the strangest assignments of his career. Professor Brandon and his daughter Doree are convinced that an ancient papyrus may contain evidence linking early Egyptian civilization to a distant world. What begins as an unusual expedition quickly becomes a dangerous journey far beyond Earth.
Their search takes them toward a remote planet in the Orion sector, where the mystery surrounding ancient Egypt becomes even more extraordinary. Along the way, Mallison and his companions face betrayal, kidnapping, hostile environments, and rivals determined to exploit the secret for themselves. The deeper the expedition goes, the more the line between archaeology and science fiction begins to disappear.
Bloch builds the story around an irresistible question: what if part of humanity’s ancient past had an extraterrestrial connection? Instead of treating Egypt simply as a historical setting, the tale transforms it into the starting point for a much larger cosmic mystery.
Adventure remains at the heart of the story. Mallison must rely on courage, quick thinking, and determination as the expedition becomes increasingly dangerous, while the mystery of the ancient evidence continues to pull the characters forward.
Originally associated with the January 1957 issue of Amazing Stories, Before Egypt is an entertaining example of mid-century pulp science fiction, combining lost-civilization ideas with space adventure and archaeological mystery.
This audiobook is ideal for listeners who enjoy classic science fiction, ancient mysteries, alien worlds, exploration, and vintage pulp adventure.

title: Side B: The Deeper Cut, Daily
author: Cam Tait
description:
SIDE B — Episode 1: The Origin Story.

Fifty years ago, a thirteen-year-old kid sat on a basement floor in Edmonton, listening to 630 CHED Radio. A gentleman named Bob Comfort came on the air — and nothing was ever quite the same after that.Bob had a segment called Posters for Your Mind.

He'd take the week's top song and pull the human story out of it. It was unlike anything I'd heard. And sitting there, I thought: maybe I can do that.What followed was a broadcasting course, a record collection full of scratches, and an instructor who — wisely — kept me fifty feet from the turntable.That was almost fifty years ago.
The equipment has changed. The dream hasn't.
This is Episode 1 of Side B. It's my origin story — why this podcast exists, what took so long, and what's finally made it possible. Including a part about cerebral palsy I don't talk around.
Every episode ends with a song. This one closes with Trisha Yearwood."The Song Remembers When."It'll make sense when you hear it.
Welcome to Side B. Pull up a chair.

Hosted by Lisa, educator and founder of Midlife AI, the show offers practical AI lessons and honest discussions for people navigating this new technology. Each episode explores one useful idea at a time, from working with chat tools and personalizing a digital assistant to building websites, apps, and more.
This is an exciting moment. Let’s understand these tools, use our judgment, and get a step ahead @midlifeai.co

title: Sunday Morning Seeds with Daryl Minor
author: Glenda Minor
description: Sunday Morning Seeds with Daryl Minor is a weekly 30-minute podcast designed to plant seeds of faith, hope, and inspiration in your heart every Sunday. Join Daryl as he explores scripture, shares practical life lessons, and offers encouragement to help you grow in your walk with Christ. Whether you're preparing for Sunday school, church, or reflecting on the week ahead, this podcast provides uplifting messages and thoughtful insights to deepen your faith and nurture your spiritual growth. Perfect for believers at any stage of their journey.

title: Lead with Love
author: Pineville Church
description:
Faith is more than what we believe—it’s how we live, love, and lead.
Lead with Love is a podcast by Pineville Church exploring faith in everyday life through honest conversations about family, relationships, leadership, community, and the challenges we all face.
Through real stories and practical conversations, we hope to help you grow in faith, lead with compassion, and discover how God’s love can shape the way you live.
Walk in faith. Live with hope. Guided by love.

title: RISE & Roar Podcast
author: RISE Be Transformed
description: Join Jo and Sarah as they step out in faith, embrace Holy Spirit's challenges, and share the adventures that follow. We hope these stories inspire you to say "yes," step out on your own journey, and have fun with Holy Spirit too. Enjoy!

description: Insane Kaiju Podcast is a monster movie book club podcast. Every other week we watch a monster movie and talk about it!

title: Security in Perspective
author: Optiv
description: Hosted by Rob Gregory, each episode cuts through the noise to focus on what actually matters — how security leaders make decisions, navigate tradeoffs and lead through real business pressure. No pitches. No posturing. Just candid conversations and heart-earned perspective from the people doing the job.

title: FBI Files
author: FBI Files
description: The FBI Files is an American docudrama that takes a look behind the scenes of the Federal Bureau of Investigation's crime laboratory.

title: The Rebellious Leader™
author: Mills Gray, Business Strategist
description:
Welcome to The Rebellious Leader the business podcast for smart, successful women whose businesses work, but still feel harder than they should. 
I’m Mills Gray, business coach, strategist and author of The Rebellious Leader. After 18 years in business and transforming over 200+ businesses, I’ve learned that the problem you think you have is very rarely the actual problem and another strategy isn’t always the answer.
Every Thursday, we’ll go underneath the obvious stuff: business strategy, sales, leadership, identity, psychology, positioning and the invisible rules shaping how you run your business. Expect real client stories, brilliant guests, behind-the-scenes conversations and plenty of questions that might change how you see your business.
Because better questions create better thinking. Better thinking creates better strategy.
Formerly the Soul Leaders podcast. Find me on Instagram @mills_gray or at www.cmillsgray.com.
